notes: Head placement on a comparative preposition rendered by a multi-word English frame. The unit for כְּ -> 'as far as' headed on the degree adverb 'far'; the same chapter heads מִן -> 'more than' on 'than' (ECC.2.9) and כְּ -> 'As ... so' on 'As' (ECC.2.15), and rule 24 decides against the outlier twice: its first sentence puts the head on the English token most directly realizing the source head's lexeme, which for כְּ is 'as', and its degree-word ruling keeps the adverb inside the unit while heading on the relational word. Only the target head moves, from t009 to t008.
